## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and HYG/LQD showing CREDIT STRESS ↑ (HYG 1W: -0.18% | 1M: +0.17% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.41% BELOW TREND) — mixed signals alongside SPY/TLT in RECOVERY (SPY 1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21% ABOVE TREND; TLT 1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.01% CORRECTION).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress creeping: HYG/LQD CREDIT STRESS ↑ (HYG 1W: -0.18% | 1M: +0.17% CORRECTION; LQD 1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.41% BELOW TREND). Fear easing: VXX (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling; commodity-driven reflation from oil/Energy (XLE 1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral to slightly mixed: Dollar Strength (Level 28.08; 1W: -0.14% | 1M: +0.04%) CORRECTION → flat, yield curve 1W: -0.05% | 1M: -0.30% BELOW TREND, and TLT (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.01%) CORRECTION — no clear easing/tightening bias.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND. Tech shows mixed signals: XLK (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +1.05%) ABOVE TREND but sector Tech breadth is weak — style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US marginally steady: SPY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%) ABOVE TREND. EM outperformance: EEM (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.19%) RECOVERY — EM shows relative strength vs a flat Europe/US backdrop.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation elevated: IBIT (1W: +3.03% | 1M: +23.95%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND; small cap IWM (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.75%) RECOVERY — appetite exists but breadth is narrow.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodity upside concentrated: CPER (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -1.99%) RECOVERY while gold GLD (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +4.39%) CORRECTION — industrial metals mixed, energy-led reflation persists.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy and oil strong: USO (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND and UNG (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +9.66%) ABOVE TREND — clear commodity leadership.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: Energy strength (XLE, USO, BNO all ABOVE TREND) is coherent. DIVERGENCE: sector breadth 4/11 vs pockets of ABOVE TREND ETFs (XLK, ARKK, IBIT) — tech and speculative ETFs rising even as broad sector participation is weak.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor energy/commodity exposure and select EM/innovation ETFs given asymmetric returns; reduce exposure to weak cyclicals and monitor credit stress (HYG/LQD) and the tech-breadth divergence. Bonds neutral-to-hedge (TLT CORRECTION) while volatility remains subdued (VXX BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare/Biotech — XBI (1W: +0.88% | 1M: +6.03%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary — XLY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND; Industrials — XLI (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Crude/Oil — USO (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND; Natural Gas UNG (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +9.66%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Select ags showing short-term weakness — WEAT (1W: -5.39% | 1M: +11.68%) CORRECTION; CPER (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -1.99%) RECOVERY — watch for re-acceleration.

13. Key Levels?
VXX around 20 (VXX 1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41% BELOW TREND) as a complacency watch; HYG/LQD ratio ~0.7505 (credit stress ↑) as a credit pivot; SPY/TLT 9.3686 (RECOVERY) as risk-on/risk-off threshold; Sector breadth 4/11 as the narrowness alert.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Energy and commodity-related ETFs showing strength (XLE 1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14% ABOVE TREND; USO 1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42% ABOVE TREND) while credit stress is rising (HYG 1W: -0.18% | 1M: +0.17% CORRECTION) and tech-breadth divergence (XLK 1W: +0.86% | 1M: +1.05% ABOVE TREND vs weak sector participation) is the key risk to monitor.
